original_record.subject: mathematics
original_record.question: If the binary operation * is defined by m*n = mn + m + n for any real number m and n, find the identity element under this operation.

options.D: e = 0 Use the matrices below to answer questions 22 and 23.

original_record.ai_explanation: For identity element e: m*e = m, so me + m + e = m, which simplifies to e(m+1) = 0, thus e = 0.

candidate.subject: mathematics
candidate.question: For real numbers m and n, the binary operation * is defined by m*n = mn + m + n. Find its identity element.
candidate.ai_explanation: An identity e must satisfy m*e = m for every m. Thus me + m + e = m, so e(m + 1) = 0 for every m. Taking m = 0 gives e = 0. Substitution confirms m*0 = m and 0*m = m.

original_record.subject: mathematics
original_record.question: P S R In the figure above, PQR is a semicircle while PQ and QR are chords. QS is the perpendicular from Q to the diameter PR. What is the expression for QS?
original_record.ai_explanation: By the geometric mean theorem in a semicircle, the altitude to the diameter equals the geometric mean of the segments: QS = √(PS·SR).

candidate.subject: mathematics
candidate.question: P and R are the endpoints of a diameter of a circle, and Q is a point on the semicircle. PQ and QR are chords. S lies on PR, with QS perpendicular to PR. Which expression gives the length QS?
candidate.ai_explanation: The angle PQR is 90° because PR is a diameter. The altitude QS divides the right triangle into two similar triangles, PQS and QRS. Their corresponding sides give PS/QS = QS/SR, so QS² = PS × SR. Taking the positive square root gives QS = √(PS × SR).

original_record.subject: mathematics
original_record.question: Determine the distance on the earth’s surface between two towns P(Lat. 600N, Long. 200E) and Q(Lat. 600N, Long 250W)
original_record.ai_explanation: Both towns are at latitude 60°N; the longitudinal difference is 45°, and the distance along the circle of latitude 60°N is R·cos(60°)·45°(π/180°) = 800√3π/9 km.

original_record.question: 6 cm O 6 cm The above diagram is a circle with centre O. find the area of the shaded portion.
original_record.ai_explanation: With radius 6 cm and a 60° sector, the shaded area equals the circular segment: sector area minus triangle area = 6π - 9√3 = 9(π - √3) ≈ 9(π - 2) cm².

candidate.question: Two perpendicular radii of a circle with centre O each have length 6 cm. A chord joins their endpoints. Find the area of the minor segment between this chord and the quarter-circle arc.

original_record.subject: mathematics
original_record.question: The locus of a point which is equidistant from two given fixed points is the

options.A: perpendicular bisector of the straight line joining them
options.B: parallel line to the straight line joining them
options.C: transverse to the straight line joining them
options.D: angle bisector of 900 which the straight line joining them makes with the horizontal

original_record.ai_explanation: The locus of all points equidistant from two fixed points forms the perpendicular bisector of the line segment joining them.

candidate.subject: mathematics
candidate.question: The locus of a point which is equidistant from two given fixed points is the

options.A: perpendicular bisector of the straight line joining them
options.B: parallel line to the straight line joining them
options.C: transverse to the straight line joining them
options.D: angle bisector of 90° which the straight line joining them makes with the horizontal

candidate.ai_explanation: Place the fixed points at (−a, 0) and (a, 0). Equal distances from (x, y) require (x + a)² + y² = (x − a)² + y². For two distinct fixed points, a ≠ 0, so x = 0. This is the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining the points.

original_record.subject: mathematics
original_record.question: Find the equation of the line through (5, 7) parallel to the line7x + 5y = 12
original_record.ai_explanation: Parallel lines have the same slope; the line 7x + 5y = 12 has slope -7/5, so the parallel line through (5,7) is 7x + 5y = 7(5) + 5(7) = 70.

candidate.subject: mathematics
candidate.question: Find the equation of the line through (5, 7) parallel to the line 7x + 5y = 12.
candidate.ai_explanation: A parallel line has the same coefficients of x and y, so write it as 7x + 5y = c. Substituting (5, 7) gives c = 7×5 + 5×7 = 70. Hence the required equation is 7x + 5y = 70.
